🧠 Crypto News Brief: A record $6.3B Binance hack, linked to North Korea, dragged Bitcoin below $78K and flipped sentiment to fear, while rapid fund freezes and Binance's pledge to cover all losses helped contain contagion. 🚨 Binance Hit by Record $6.3B Hack, North Korea Suspected Binance paused withdrawals after attackers drained its hot wallets in the largest crypto theft on record. The exchange traced the breach to a compromised DevOps engineer's laptop, while TRM Labs attributed the attack to an elite North Korean hacking unit. Read full story 🛡️ Binance Reserves $6.34B to Make Users Whole Binance says it has set aside more than $6.34B of company funds, about $5B already held in the affected tokens, and will cover all losses through SAFU and corporate reserves. Deposits run normally; withdrawals are expected back within roughly 48 hours. More details 🧊 Tether, Circle and Arbitrum Freeze Stolen Funds Around $3B of the stolen assets is now frozen on-chain. Tether and Circle locked stablecoins tied to the attacker, and Arbitrum's Security Council moved 74.56M ARB from the hacker's wallet into a frozen intermediary address. Read more 📉 Bitcoin Hits Six-Week Low as $1.5B in Bets Liquidated BTC slid to about $76,460 before rebounding toward $78,500 as the hack triggered $1.53B in forced liquidations, roughly $1.29B of them long positions. The company now holds 848,517 BTC and has raised $21.2B in capital year to date. Read full story 🇰🇷 South Korea Weighs Fourth Delay to Crypto Tax The ruling Democratic Party met heads of the country's five largest exchanges on Friday to discuss postponing the 22% crypto income tax due in January 2027, citing gaps in overseas trading data. A pending bill would push the start to 2029. 81485.body: Отримайте Balance Protection для своїх коштів в Aave App table { border-spacing: 0; mso-table-lspace: 0pt; mso-table-rspace: 0pt; } img { border: 0; outline: none; -ms-interpolation-mode: bicubic; } @media only screen and (max-width: 520px) { .page-padding { padding: 32px 16px !important; } .card-content { padding: 32px !important; } .footer-link { padding: 0 6px !important; font-size: 11px !important; } } body, table, td, a, h1, p { font-family: 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif !important; } Отримайте Balance Protection для своїх коштів в Aave App Отримайте Balance Protection для свого облікового запису. Зареєструйтесь, щоб отримати додатковий рівень захисту для балансів у Aave App, які відповідають вимогам. Виконайте вимоги лише за кілька кроків: Налаштуйте додаток-автентифікатор Додайте $1,000 Підтримуйте баланс понад $1,000, щоб зберігати захист Налаштуйте відновлення облікового запису Базовий рівень покриття становить до $100,000 на особу; право на участь, суми покриття та ліміти визначаються і регулюються умовами програми.
